record.question: Motherboard is also known as:
record.explanation: A motherboard is a printed circuit board that carries and connects major computer components. More precisely it is a particular type of PCB, commonly called a system board/mainboard; not every PCB is a motherboard. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026.
